title: LANDMARKS IN MEDIA CONTENT
description: Introduces students to media content that represents advances in the art and science of creative use of media technology. Some of these advances were recognized immediately, some only after time had passed.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: (NMC 101 or 101H) and NMC 260.
A minimum grade of C- is required in NMC 101, NMC 101H and NMC 260.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Digital Communication Arts (473) or New Media Communications (619).
recommendations: WR II completed with a passing grade.
meeting_html: MW 4pm-5:20pm in STAG 113 - Strand Agriculture Hall 113 (GP) (9/23 to 12/4)
